bullet: Crash after a mid-call pause (`F05.pause-running-crash`), known bug.
script:
H=$(control-agent-server sink read --name qa-f05-hang | python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["requests"])')
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true
control-agent-server conversation wait "$K" --until running --timeout 60
control-agent-server sink read --name qa-f05-hang --expect-min $((H + 1)) --wait 30
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K/pause" --expect 200 --check success eq true --expect-max-ms 3000
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/search --query status=paused --check items contains "$K"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K/events/count" --query kind=$PAUSE_KIND --check . eq 2
control-agent-server restart --hard
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K/events/count" --query kind=$PAUSE_KIND --check . eq 2
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K" --check execution_status eq paused --quiet --save F05.pause-running-crash/get  # bug
failed_command: control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true
